6702:
[יָצַת] _vb_. **kindle**, **burn** (intr.)
**Qal** **kindle**, intr., fig. of wickedness; sq. **be kindled with fire** (= set on fire)
**Niph**. **be kindled**; **be burned**; = **desolated**
**Hiph**. **kindle**, **set on fire**
6714:
צֹ֫חַר _n.pr.m_.
**1.** father of Ephron the Hittite
**2.** son of Simeon
**3.** name in Judah
6717: צִיבָא and צִבָא 16 _n.pr.m_. servant of Saul’s house
6721: צִידוֹן and צִידֹן _n.pr.loc_. **Sidôn**, ancient Phoenician city, on coast N. of Tyre;—‘first-born’ of Canaan
6722: צִידֹנִי _adj.gent_. of foregoing [r.bs.ai]; as subst. = **Sidonians**; in earlier lit. appar. = **Phoenicians**
6730: צִיעֹר _n.pr.loc_. [[06-joshua.15.54|Jos 15:54]], prob. **Ṣâ‛îr**, 5 m. NNE. fr. Hebron
6731: צִיץ _n.[m.]_ meaning dubious; only in [[24-jeremiah.48.9|Je 48:9]] usu. **wings**
6737: [צִיד] _vb. denom_. **Hithp**. **supply oneself with provisions**, **take as one's provision**
6751:
[צָלַל] _vb_. **be** or **grow dark**
**Qal** **the gates of Jerusalem grew dark**, i.e. evening came on
**Hiph**. **a shadowing wood**
6753: הַצְּלֶלְפּוֹנִי _n.pr.f_. in Judah (**give shade**, thou **that turnest to me!**) [[13-1-chronicles.4.3|1 Ch 4:3]]
6756:
צַלְמוֹן _n.pr.mont_.
**1.** near Shechem, not identif.
**2.** snow-capped mt., prob. E. of Jordan
צַלְמוֹן _n.pr.m_. a hero of David [[10-2-samuel.23.28|2 S 23:28]]
6758: צַלְמֹנָה _n.pr.loc_. station of Isr. in wilderness
6762: צֵלַע _n.pr.loc_. in Benj.; burial-place of Saul
6767: צֶלְצְלִים _n.m.pl_. musical instr. of percussion, **cymbals** (with **clashing** sound)
6775:
[צָמַד] _vb_. **bind**, **join**
**Niph**. **join**, **attach**, **oneself** to Baal Peor, i.e. adopt his worship
**Pu**. a sword **bound** upon his loins
**Hiph**. **thy tongue combineth** (fitteth together, frameth) **deceit**
6776:
צֶ֫מֶד _n.m_. **couple**, **pair**
**1.** **couple**, **pair**, usu. of animals
**2.** a measure of land (only square measure in OT) like **acre**; orig. appar. what a **span** can plough
6779:
צָמַח _vb_. **sprout**, **spring up**
**Qal** **sprout**, **spring up**
**Pi**. **grow abundantly**
**Hiph**.
**1.** **cause to grow**
**2.** of rain, **cause** the earth **to sprout**
6786: צְמָרִי _adj.gent_. (people of the city called _Ṣimirra_ by As.)
6787:
צְמָרַיִם _n.pr.loc_.
**1.** in Benj.
**2.** mt. in Ephraim
6789:
[צָמַת] _vb_. **put an end to**, **exterminate**
**Qal** **they have put an end to my life**
**Niph**. **be ended**, **annihilated**
**Pi**. **hath put an end to me**
**Pi‛lēl** thine alarms **have annihilated me**
**Hiph**. **exterminate**, **annihilate**
6790: צִן _n.pr.loc_. name of wilderness S. of Canaan, where lay Kadesh Barnea
